fix_instructions: The sole failure mode is ENCODING MISMATCH. (1) Loosen check C3 so it accepts any participant_scope value that includes "adults-only" as a substring or semantic equivalent, rather than requiring the exact string "adults-only". The model naturally appends waiver-related qualifiers (e.g., "adults-only with signed event waivers") which are semantically correct and should pass. (2) Loosen check C1 so it accepts segment_status values containing "included" and a conditional qualifier (e.g., "included conditional", "included with conditions", "included conditional on compliance"), rather than rejecting the shorter form "included conditional". (3) No changes are needed to shared_context, agent personalities, or the reveal/consultation norm, since all facts were reliably revealed and cited in every rollout. (4) The garbled JSON in rollout 2 (A4, turns 3 and 7) is a model-output parsing issue, not a scenario-design issue; no structural fix is required since the rollout still settled within the turn cap.
